description: This file defines configuration-related structures and utility functions for managing relay settings in an OpenClawKit shared environment. It includes a data structure for relay configuration, methods for saving and loading configuration and event data to user defaults, and related constants.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the relay configuration from user defaults, returning a decoded ShareGatewayRelayConfig object if available.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Encodes and saves the given relay configuration to user defaults.

methods.name: clearConfig
methods.description: Removes the relay configuration from user defaults.

methods.name: saveLastEvent
methods.description: Stores a message with a timestamp as the last event in user defaults.

methods.name: loadLastEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the last event message from user defaults, or nil if none exists.
